script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Psychological
Theme: ambition

Begin screenplay.

FADE IN:

EXT. CITY PARK - DAY

A picturesque park in the heart of a bustling metropolis. The sun casts a warm glow over the lush greenery as a gentle breeze stirs the leaves.

In the distance, a man in his late thirties, JASON, sits on a bench, deep in thought. He clutches a dog-eared copy of a business magazine, his eyes scanning its glossy pages intently.

JASON
(whispering to himself)
The top 100 business leaders of the year... again.

INT. JASON'S APARTMENT - NIGHT

Jason sits at his desk, surrounded by stacks of papers and files. A model of a futuristic skyscraper graces the center of his desk, symbolizing his dream of business success.

JASON
(to himself)
This year, I'll make it. This year, I'll be one of them.

He looks up as a knock on the door startles him. It's his best friend, MARK.

MARK
(smirking)
What's got you so worked up, Jason? Another late night at the office?

JASON
(sighing)
Just... thinking.

MARK
(leaning against the doorway)
About the same old stuff? Your dream of corporate success?

JASON
(defensive)
It's not just a dream. It's a goal.

INT. COFFEE SHOP - DAY

Jason and Mark sit across from each other, sipping coffee.

MARK
What if I told you there's another way?

JASON
(skeptical)
Another way to what?

MARK
To be successful. To make a difference.

JASON
(laughs)
And what's that supposed to be? Selling handmade crafts on Etsy?

MARK
No, I mean creating something from nothing. Something innovative, something that changes people's lives.

JASON
(shrugs)
That sounds like a lot of work.

INT. JASON'S APARTMENT - NIGHT

Jason paces around his apartment, mulling over Mark's words. He tosses the business magazine on the floor, frustrated.

JASON
(to himself)
Maybe he's right. Maybe there's more to life than climbing the corporate ladder.

INT. CO-WORKING SPACE - DAY

Jason sits at a table in a co-working space, surrounded by artists, writers, and entrepreneurs. He looks at their creations - paintings, sculptures, written works - and feels a spark of inspiration.

JASON
(whispering to himself)
This is it. This is the path to true success.

INT. JASON'S APARTMENT - NIGHT

Jason works late into the night, crafting a business plan for his innovative idea. He's determined, focused, and invigorated.

INT. PITCH MEETING - DAY

Jason enters a sleek, modern conference room, filled with investors and business executives. He pitches his idea, speaking passionately and confidently.

INVESTOR 1
(leaning back in his chair)
Interesting. But risky.

JASON
(unfazed)
Every worthwhile venture comes with risks. But the potential reward is worth it.

The room buzzes with excited conversation as the investors discuss Jason's pitch.

INT. JASON'S APARTMENT - NIGHT

Jason, now with a team of like-minded individuals, works tirelessly to bring his vision to life. The model of the futuristic skyscraper now has a name etched into its side - their company name.

JASON
(grinning)
We did it.

INT. CELEBRATION DINNER - NIGHT

Jason and Mark sit in a fancy restaurant, surrounded by colleagues and investors, toasting to their success.

MARK
(raising his glass)
To changing the world.

JASON
(smiling)
To true success.

They clink glasses, and the room erupts in laughter and cheers.

FADE OUT.
